doc.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12

title: Hammer ring track and Oster's first recording visit
summary: They play the hammer ring song, whose lead singer is on the record cover, and recall it as the first song sung when the professor first came.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: 59. Correction is 59. Yeah. Correction is 59. I got transferred here. Okay. Let's take a listen to this third band here. That's your hammer ring. He's going to be on here if you can put it on there. Right there. Big wide one there. Oh, that's it. I'll get it. Yeah, there it is. Right there.
That's Louisiana. The fellow that we're on the cover of this thing. He's carrying the lead on that song. Yeah, he's carrying the lead on that song. And I'm on the background of that song.
That was our first song that we had started singing when Mr. Austin first came here.
And that was the one he was favorite when Mr. Austin lied to that song when we sang it for him. That's a good one. Yeah. That's the only man I've seen.
Right on the cover there. Yes, sir. This other fellow was in on this record?

No, sir. He wasn't in on that one because I was clear that when he came, he was about the third or fourth appearance that Mr. Howard, the professor, that came here. That was his first appearance when this Lou Zander sang that song.
